title: Jade-Cooked Chinese Pork Cai Fun
description: A cultured, dense and flavorful Chinese dish, featuring pork, vegetables, and a unique bicarbonate of soda marinade, all cooked to perfection in a stone bowl.
instructions: Cut the pork into thin strips and place in a large bowl.
In a small bowl, mix together soy sauce, oyster sauce, bicarbonate of soda, salt, and black pepper.
Add the marinade to the pork and mix well to coat.
Let the pork marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large wok or frying pan over high heat.
Add the pork to the wok and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until browned and cooked through.
Remove the pork from the wok and set aside.
In the same wok, add the remaining 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil.
Add the bok choy, mushrooms, and bell pepper to the wok and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Return the pork to the wok and stir in the cooked vegetables.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the pork and vegetables are well combined.
Serve the Jade-Cooked Chinese Pork Cai Fun hot, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds.
Cook the cai fun noodles according to package instructions and serve alongside the pork and vegetables.
